tree.heading: Inspection.—
tree.text: A member, or an agent or attorney of the member, may inspect the records of the corporation for any proper purpose, at any reasonable time.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 3030936:863.Aug. 27, 1958, Pub. L. 85–769, § 13, 72 Stat. 926. The word “records” is substituted for “books and records” for consistency in the revised title and with other titles of the United States Code.
